notes.title: March Update v1.0.5.14
notes.notes:
[h2]Our March update is here! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/43270e6215f2132335ceb3af37c01434680c5efe.png[/img]

Unfortunately we were not able to get the needed translations for the new witch, potions, or NPC hobbies so we're pushing those updates until next month. We did get some of April's quality of life updates in though!

You can now lock inventory rows in the items tab which will keep those items in place while sorting, mass transferring to or from chests, and will only add to that row if every other one is full. Inventory cycling is also available in game; use tilde or D-pad right to shift each row. The chest screen also has new buttons to quickly transfer similar items or just take everything from a chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/d5b9c73ec4e45a50f2a82e78e48c2ae0e0ef2d53.png[/img]

[*] Added Thunderstorms, a rare Spring and Summer weather type
[*] Added Tree Tapper - You can add them to pine or maple tree and collect pine sap or maple syrup every 3 days during winter
[*] Added Inventory Bar Locking
[*] Added Inventory Bar Cycling: ` (tilde) or D-pad right
[*] Added Chest transfer button
[*] Reduced Experience needed for higher foraging levels
[*] Waddle fences are now made with Sticks instead of Wood
[/list]

Thank you for being part of this journey with us! Stay tuned for more updates next month.

notes.title: Fall Update
notes.notes:
Happy Fall 🍁
We’re happy to roll out an update that’s focused on some quality of life updates to enhance your time while playing Echoes of the Plum Grove! 

Check out what's new:

[h3]Update Highlights:[/h3]

   [list]
[*]  [b]Inventory Management Made Easier:[/b] A new dropdown feature has been added to help you sort inventory and chests with ease.
[*]     [b]Tailor Shop Refresh:[/b] The tailor's inventory will now shuffle cosmetics you’ve already purchased.
[*] [b]    Gifting Medicine & More:[/b] You can now gift medicine, potions, or soap to help prevent or heal diseases in NPCS or family members. These items follow the gifting cooldown, so plan wisely!
[*]   [b]  Smarter Family Movement: [/b]Family members will now spend less time blocking the stairs or lingering in the entryway.
[*]    [b] Pet Cap Increased:[/b] You can now have up to [b]5 pets[/b]! More critters for your family to love and care for.
[*]    [b] Improved Shop & Storage Control[/b]: Updates for smoother interactions while navigating shops and storage.
[*]     [b]Tidying Up Achievements:[/b] We’ve removed unreleased content from the achievements list and collection book to ensure everything matches the current in-game content.
[/list]

Thank you all for your continued support and feedback! We're constantly looking for ways to improve the game, so keep sharing your thoughts with us.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 is live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/dd8a0cbfbb4edaaec89a17d8bf8de5cbe0d9fdc4.png[/img]
Can you believe it's been 2 weeks since we've launched? So many of you have shown your support for our cozy lil' game and we can't thank you enough.

It took us a bit, but we wanted to make sure we had everything as polished as we could make it for this update. We did our best to tackle as many bugs as possible and rebalanced a few things based on community feedback. Along with some adorable new features like the additional pet skins, this update also includes [b]full controller support[/b] and [b]basic modding capabilities[/b]!

Along with those key features and all of the updates listed in the patch notes below, we've also started to compile a list of frequently asked questions. You can check out the current list on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1536090/discussions/0/4356747375212494978/]Plum Grove FAQ[/url] in the Steam Discussion board.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/d3ea497728e5ac95fd6e6a0f29976a96b18f4f52.png[/img]
We know of a few issues that remain with controller support which we are continuing to work on. We will be monitoring both our Discord and the Steam Discussions closely to make sure everything is working smoothly outside of these remaining issues.
[list][*] Interact button on your farm
[*] Shop/Chest menu
[*] Pressing A when talking should complete the current text first
[*] Item drop hovers
[*] Inability to input text
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/8d3cd8748bdc342a894be26c8f337ea7e5e7a05e.png[/img]
The world of community-led modding for Plum Grove has officially begun! Basic mod support has been added to the game and the community has already started creating. Make sure to backup your saves and use the mod support at your own risk when it comes to save files and progression. Join our [url=discord.gg/unwound]discord[/url] to find more information on mods.
[list][*] Unzip https://unwoundgames.com/mods/cosmetics.zip to your game's data path: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Unwound Games\Echoes of the Plum Grove\mods
[*] Type in "mods" into the redeem code box
[/list]

notes.title: Echoes of the Plum Grove Release Day Reveal!🌟
notes.notes:
Guess what? Today we finally announced the launch date for Echoes of the Plum Grove during the Mix Online Showcase! You can [url=https://youtu.be/dtdi4rBlAv0]watch our trailer here [/url]!

[b]Echoes of the Plum Grove will be fully launching on [u]April 29, 2024[/u] - and we’re just as excited as you are![/b]

⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/f09adbc4acf94853c32b3dbb1a4991ccc615ee46.gif[/img]

We'll be launching with over 200 character customization options and 10 different colors to dye clothes with, 186 furniture pieces, and 34 different seasonal crops to grow. It's been one heck of a ride getting here - 6 years, to be exact. But what a journey it's been, filled with lots and lots of drawing, tea and late nights.
⠀⠀⠀⠀ [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/ed28751f1c4d65f86f6d07c77850a0ab7e543bfa.png[/img]
This game is a huge part of our lives. While working on it, we got married, moved, and welcomed our corgi, Wylla, into the family. Working on Echoes of the Plum Grove also allowed us to travel! We got to go and do research in Colonial Williamsburg and Salem Massachusetts to study up on what it was like to live in a small hamlet in the 1700's. We’ve been through a lot, and we want to say a massive thank you for sticking with us. Your support means the world, and we couldn’t have done it without our amazing community. 

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/ecbe107fb645a6dcccdc85b2a54df8d26c42b858.gif[/img]
So, stay tuned for more information as we get closer to launch, we'll be updating you all on any extra content we add before then. If you haven't wishlisted the game yet, make sure to, so you can get notified when we go live! We can’t wait for you to play Echoes of the Plum Grove so soon!

Much love,

Sarah, Erik & Wylla 🐾

notes.title: Season's Greetings from Honeywood & Kickstarter Update
notes.notes:
As the snow blankets Honeywood, and villagers decorate their homes with festive wreaths, it's time to welcome the awaited Winter Gala! The island is abuzz with excitement, and all the villagers are excited to to bring this festive celebration to life!
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/e78c1421d894742fd2b8e78be920c87781bddfae.png[/img]
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/ecbe107fb645a6dcccdc85b2a54df8d26c42b858.gif[/img]

Throughout the day of the Winter Gala, the Cranberry Collection Contest begins, scattered across the island are 40 cranberries, waiting to be discovered. Depending on how many you collect, rewards range from a modest sum of money to significant social boosts with the villagers. It's a delightful way to explore the island, and who knows what secrets you might uncover along the way!

As evening falls, the Town Hall becomes the center of festivities. Don't miss the punch bowl at the event - it's not just a drink station, but also an indicator of your success in the Cranberry Collection Contest. The more cranberries you gather, the more full the punch bowl is!
⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/4ad5bcfa4f585a4416cbde125ca9136269d1d721.gif[/img]

We're incredibly excited for you to experience these winter festivities in Echoes of the Plum Grove. Remember, the Gala is just a glimpse of the myriad of events and surprises that await you in Honeywood.

[b]Speaking of a myriad of events, our Kickstarter was fully funded![/b]
We ended with 757 backers, and a total of  $29,909 pledged. So many exciting stretch goals were reached and we can't wait to begin implementing them before our 1.0 launch!
⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/ed28751f1c4d65f86f6d07c77850a0ab7e543bfa.png[/img]

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43288680/eaeb77a3e28925388ee7b9545a9737c5142233e7.png[/img]
